title: Persist session song titles
prompt:
In lib/models/metronome_session.dart, add an optional song title snapshot to the model and preserve it through JSON and copyWith. Make these exact replacements:
1. Replace `    this.songId,` with `    this.songId,\n    this.songTitle,`.
2. Replace `      songId: json['songId'] as String?,` with `      songId: json['songId'] as String?,\n      songTitle: json['songTitle'] as String?,`.
3. Replace `  final String? songId;` with `  final String? songId;\n  final String? songTitle;`.
4. Replace `    if (songId != null) 'songId': songId,` with `    if (songId != null) 'songId': songId,\n    if (songTitle != null) 'songTitle': songTitle,`.
5. Replace `    String? songId,` with `    String? songId,\n    String? songTitle,`.
6. Replace `      songId: songId ?? this.songId,` with `      songId: songId ?? this.songId,\n      songTitle: songTitle ?? this.songTitle,`.
In each replacement, turn the displayed `\n` into an actual newline. Existing sessions without the field must continue to deserialize. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq "songTitle: json['songTitle'] as String?," lib/models/metronome_session.dart && rg -Fq "if (songTitle != null) 'songTitle': songTitle," lib/models/metronome_session.dart && rg -Fq 'songTitle: songTitle ?? this.songTitle,' lib/models/metronome_session.dart && dart analyze lib/models/metronome_session.dart

title: Capture metronome song title
prompt:
In lib/providers/data/metronome_provider.dart, save the active song title at session start and carry it to the completed session. Replace `      songId: state.activeSong?.id,` with `      songId: state.activeSong?.id,
      songTitle: state.activeSong?.title,`. Replace `      songId: session.songId,` with `      songId: session.songId,
      songTitle: session.songTitle,`. Turn each displayed `
` into an actual newline. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'songTitle: state.activeSong?.title,' lib/providers/data/metronome_provider.dart && rg -Fq 'songTitle: session.songTitle,' lib/providers/data/metronome_provider.dart && dart analyze lib/providers/data/metronome_provider.dart

title: Capture practice region context
verify: rg -Fq 'songTitle: _sessionSongTitle,' lib/screens/practice_regions_screen.dart && rg -Fq "? 'Section ${index + 1}'" lib/screens/practice_regions_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/practice_regions_screen.dart

title: Show saved titles in history
prompt:
In lib/screens/practice_screen.dart, replace the exact block `      final song = s.songId == null
          ? 'Freestyle'
          : titles[s.songId] ?? missingTitle;` with `      final snapshot = s.songTitle?.trim();
      final currentTitle = titles[s.songId];
      final song = s.songId == null
          ? 'Freestyle'
          : snapshot != null && snapshot.isNotEmpty
          ? currentTitle == null
                ? '$snapshot · $missingTitle'
                : snapshot
          : currentTitle ?? missingTitle;`. Turn the displayed `
` sequences into actual newlines. This displays the recorded title and the existing loading, unavailable, or removed status when the source cannot be found; older sessions keep their existing fallback. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -Fq 'final snapshot = s.songTitle?.trim();' lib/screens/practice_screen.dart && rg -Fq 'currentTitle == null' lib/screens/practice_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/practice_screen.dart && flutter test test/screens/practice_screen_test.dart
